description: Ask the person you are talking to for help, when you are stuck, cannot tell which of several things they mean, find the request unclear, or need them to look at something. Posts your question into this 1:1 and rings their phone. With device_session_id (a live session on their computer) their phone also shows the computer's screen, and they can point at it. Only works in an encrypted 1:1 with exactly one other person. At most six asks an hour per chat; asking again withdraws the open one. Close it with close_help_request when you have what you need.

chat_id.description: Optional: defaults to the current chat.

device_session_id.description: Optional: the live device session this is about.

question.description: Your question in plain words, at most 500 characters.

reason.description: stuck: you cannot proceed. which: several things could be meant. unclear: the request is vague. look: you want them to see the screen.

name: ask_for_help
